explanation: At (-1/2,1), y'=1/(1+1/4)=4/5≠0, so the point is neither stationary nor a local maximum. Differentiating and substituting the differential equation gives y''=y(1-2x)/(1+x^2)^2. At the point, y''=32/25>0 and remains positive nearby by continuity, so there is no inflection point. All three statements are false.
